title: The Submerged Shelf That Returns Questions

features.name: the flowing shelf
features.desc-on-touch: the stone holds water like a question holds breath; every channel the flow has cut is a choice the shelf will answer

features.name: the spring point
features.desc-on-touch: water breaks the surface here, and for a moment you hear it deciding which way to flow

features.name: the amendment notations

features.name: the return current

features.name: the deepening reach

reverie.title: REVERIE — the shelf where questions rest
narr: You stand in shallow water. The shelf slopes away beneath
your feet, stone polished smooth. Leif points at something
the current has carved — not quite words, but a shape like a
question. He asks: "Does the water ask the stone, or does
the stone ask the water?" The flow answers for both of them.

exits.label: back up where the limestone begins its slow learning
deeper, where the shelf gives way to unmarked water
westward along underground channels, where water speaks in echoes
along the visible rim where limestone meets the current's decision
